title: The check and the farewell
lead: The final moments shape what guests carry home. Make them as intentional as the first.

sections.name: Closing the check
know: Never rush the check comes when asked, or when they signal.
As intentional as the first moments of the meal.

sections.name: The farewell

lines.label: In short
lines.text: Did every guest feel we were on their side?

know: By name thank them, and mention their occasion.
To the door walk them out whenever you can.
Notes add them to the profile for next time.
Their side the measure of our service.

keyPoints.line: the check comes when asked, or when they signal.
as the first moments of the meal.

read.where: The final moments **shape what guests carry home**. Make them as **intentional as the first**.

stops.name: Never rush
stops.text: Present the check **when requested** or **when the table signals**. **Process payment promptly.**

read.sayIt: No rush at all, whenever you’re ready.

keyPoints.line: thank them, and mention their occasion.
walk them out whenever you can.
add them to the profile for next time.

read.bigIdea: Did every guest feel we were on their side?
read.where: **The measure of our service:** did every guest feel that we were **on their side**?

stops.name: Make it personal
stops.text: Thank them **by name**, and refer to something you learned, such as their **occasion** or a **favorite dish**.

stops.name: Walk them out
stops.text: Whenever possible, **escort guests to the door** and **invite them back** warmly; **add notes to their profile** for next time.

read.sayIt: It was a true pleasure having you tonight. Happy anniversary, and we can’t wait to welcome you back.

sources: Baldwin Restaurant Group, The Art of Table Service: 13, Closing the Check and Heartfelt Farewell.

cards.q: When do you present the check?
cards.answer: When it’s requested, or when the table signals
wrong: As soon as dessert is served
Right after the entrées are cleared
cards.source: Baldwin Restaurant Group, The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.q: What do you say as you present the check?
cards.answer: “No rush at all, whenever you’re ready.”
cards.source: Baldwin Restaurant Group, The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.q: Why make the final moments intentional?
cards.answer: They shape what guests carry home
wrong: They’re the quickest part of service
cards.source: Baldwin Restaurant Group, The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.q: How do you thank a guest at the farewell?
cards.answer: By name, referring to something you learned about them
wrong: With an offer for next time
With the same line for every table
cards.source: Baldwin Restaurant Group, The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.q: Whenever possible, at the end of the meal you…
cards.answer: Escort guests to the door and invite them back
wrong: Reset the table while they put on coats
cards.source: Baldwin Restaurant Group, The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.q: What is the measure of our service?
cards.answer: Whether every guest felt we were on their side
cards.source: Baldwin Restaurant Group, The Art of Table Service (service training module)

cards.q: After the farewell, what goes in the guest’s profile?
cards.source: Baldwin Restaurant Group, The Art of Table Service (service training module)
